title: Glycine-Sodium Hydroxide Buffer Preparation
author: Neilier Junior
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfyjjpun

steps.title: Prepare glycine and NaOH solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.1 M glycine (7.5 g L⁻¹, MW 75.0 g mol⁻¹) and 0.1 M sodium hydroxide (4.0 g L⁻¹, MW 40.0 g mol⁻¹). Pipette 50 mL of the glycine solution into a container and add the indicated volume of the sodium hydroxide solution to obtain a pH between 8.6 and 10.6.

steps.title: Adjust final volume
steps.instruction: Add deionized water to the mixture until the total volume reaches 200 mL.

steps.title: Fine‑tune pH
steps.instruction: Measure the pH with a calibrated sensitive pH meter and, if necessary, adjust to reach the target pH range of 8.6–10.6.
